template.one_beat.title: One line, one beat
template.one_beat.summary: Every line the player says is an action: the world resolves it at once and writes the result. For fast-paced adventure, exploration and action worlds.

node.resolve.title: Resolve
node.resolve.summary: The line is taken as an action: everyone present reacts, one narration writes the beat, and the checked changes go into the world.

kind.mode: A play layer: inside it, the layer's own host writes the beat (a fight, say); when it is done the turn goes back to Resolve.
kind.place: A place layer: entered when the player walks into a place of this kind (a dungeon room, say), left when they walk out.
kind.one_shot: A one-off layer: it takes one beat (asking the rules referee first, say), then the turn goes back to Resolve.
kind.phase: A phase: one of the world's phases (day / night, say); the turn moves here when the phase changes.
on.gate: the rules call for this layer

preset.chat_only.title: Chat only
preset.chat_only.summary: On the phone you send a line and they answer with one or a few. They do not act on their own. Every character starts with this.

soul.node.chat.title: Chat
soul.node.chat.summary: You send a line; they answer with one or a few.

soul.node.tick.title: Their own day
soul.node.tick.summary: While you are away they do a small everyday thing now and then, and sometimes text you.

soul.node.reflect.title: Reflect
soul.node.reflect.summary: Every few times, recent things are folded into lasting memory.

history.title: Recent messages
history.doc: the last few lines you exchanged

bubbles.title: Split into bubbles
bubbles.doc: one to a few bubbles, maybe a sticker

ambient.title: What now
ambient.doc: their routine for this time of day

doing.title: One small thing
doing.doc: the model picks one small thing they would do now

message.title: Maybe text you
message.doc: now and then a message (capped per day)

fold.title: Fold
fold.doc: the model keeps a few lines worth keeping
